WITH budget_event_matched AS (
  SELECT b.*, e.status
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_level AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    status,
    AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining,
    AVG(CASE WHEN amount != 0 THEN (spent - amount) / CAST(amount AS REAL) END) as avg_overspend_rate
  FROM budget_event_matched
  GROUP BY link_to_event, status
),
status_level AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    AVG(avg_remaining) as avg_remaining_per_status,
    AVG(avg_overspend_rate) as avg_overspend_rate_per_status
  FROM event_level
  GROUP BY status
),
mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_per_status) as simple_mean_remaining
  FROM status_level
)
SELECT 
  s.status,
  s.avg_remaining_per_status as average_remaining,
  s.avg_overspend_rate_per_status as average_overspend_rate,
  s.avg_remaining_per_status / m.simple_mean_remaining as scaled_remaining
FROM status_level s
CROSS JOIN mean_calc m
ORDER BY s.status
